name: Password Sign-In Flow Handler
summary: Provides the typed application boundary for password authentication and classifies manager results into canonical Success, MFA Required, Rejected, or Locked Out transitions.
notes: The handler does not implement credential validation; it delegates to ISignInManager and classifies only stable modeled result codes.
AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired maps to the MFA Required transition before the generic successful branch.
AUTH001 maps to Rejected and AUTH030 maps to Locked Out; unexpected failures are not silently collapsed into Rejected.
AuthenticationFlowService is the stable application front door and validates that emitted transitions belong to this set.

sourceReferences.note: Implemented typed handler and canonical four-outcome transition classification.
Stable application front door validates Password Sign In transitions.
Domain manager owns password authentication, MFA-required normalization, public result codes and auth-log events.
